post.caption:
Your brain has no lymphatic drainage like the rest of your body, so it runs its own: the glymphatic system. During sleep, brain cells contract, the gaps between them widen, and cerebrospinal fluid floods through to clear the day's metabolic waste, including proteins associated with Alzheimer's. Clearance runs far harder in deep sleep than it ever does awake. Sleep is not downtime. It is scheduled maintenance the brain cannot run while you are using it.
